usageGuidelines: Use this after the compact pressure-state tool when a user asks for drivers, validation, z-scores, thresholds, or full ATLAS-7 readiness.

Preserve audit_status, current_bucket, previous_bucket, bucket_comparison, z_scores, threshold_contract, threshold_flags, canonical_event, event_classification, four_level_coverage, constituent_contributions, presentation_parity, trident, question_readiness, provenance, caveats, and quality_flags in summaries.
If canonical_event.canonical_event_status is not confirmed, describe the output as a linked-market pressure read, not a full four-level ATLAS-7 verdict or certified release event.

description: Use this read-only audit tool when the user asks what factors drive the Delta Signal Synthetic AI 10 ETF state, asks for raw audit evidence, or asks whether the current pressure state is a full four-level ATLAS-7 verdict. It returns current and previous buckets, bucket comparison, factor-history rows, audit-window z-scores including basis_pressure_z, a threshold contract, threshold flags, canonical event status/reasons/blockers, event classification, four-level coverage, bounded constituent contribution rows, presentation-parity status, TRIDENT/liquidation-gradient availability, per-question readiness, provenance, caveats, and quality flags. Parameters: product is required and accepts AI10, Synthetic AI10 ETF, AI-PERP-INTX, Tech100, or TEK-19DEC30-CDE; optional source-date filters override window_days; optional limit and offset paginate factor-history rows. Behavior: read-only and idempotent with no destructive side effects; it must label partial coverage explicitly and must not convert a linked-market read into issuer truth, exchange-native microstructure truth, a trade signal, or investment advice.

include_export.description: Whether to include export availability metadata. Defaults true.

limit.description: Maximum factor-history rows to return. Defaults to 100 and is capped at 100 through MCP.

offset.description: Pagination offset over factor-history rows used for audit.

product.description: Required Synthetic ETF or linked product identifier, for example AI10, Synthetic AI10 ETF, or AI-PERP-INTX.

source_date.description: Optional exact source date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Overrides window_days.

source_date_from.description: Optional inclusive source-date lower bound in YYYY-MM-DD format.

source_date_to.description: Optional inclusive source-date upper bound in YYYY-MM-DD format.

window_days.description: Default audit lookback when no source-date filters are supplied. Defaults to 7 and is capped at 30.

name: deltasignal_synthetic_etf_audit

outputSchema.description: DeltaSignal ATLAS-7 MCPResponse wrapper. Raw tool payload is returned under data.

audit_status.description: complete or partial, based on z-score, threshold, and four-level coverage availability.

bucket_comparison.description: Side-by-side current/prior ST, LSI, FDI, FEI, ECS proxy, basis pressure, and deltas.

canonical_event.description: Canonical event status, type, reason, blockers, linked state, and evidence boundary.

caveats.description: Audit caveats for client display and contract validation.

computed_at_utc.description: UTC computation timestamp from the current factor row.

constituent_contributions.description: Bounded constituent attribution rows. Current implementation exposes weight-only contribution rows and missing per-constituent pressure fields instead of inferring drivers.

current_bucket.description: Current factor bucket with factors, deltas, market inputs, quality, and evidence hash.

disclosures.description: Synthetic benchmark, source-boundary, and non-advice disclosures.

event_classification.description: Canonical event classification distinct from the linked-market pressure read.

evidence_boundary.description: Boundary statement separating linked-market evidence from full ATLAS verdict language.

factor_history.description: Returned factor rows, pagination, and export availability metadata.

four_level_coverage.description: Level 1 issuer truth, Level 2 equity behavior, Level 3 basket pressure, and Level 4 linked-product coverage.

identity_lineage.description: Canonical synthetic benchmark identity and method-continuity metadata.

linked_product.description: Linked market product used for Level 4 evidence where available.

method_version.description: Version label for the audit compositor.

observed_bucket_utc.description: UTC observed bucket represented by the current factor row.

presentation_parity.description: Rendered artifact parity status. Returns requires_artifact until a rendered HTML/article artifact is provided for comparison.

pressure_state.description: Linked-market pressure read from the current factor row.

previous_bucket.description: Previous returned factor bucket for comparison, or unavailable status.

product.description: Canonical linked product identifier used to read factor history.

provenance.description: Source dates, method versions, row counts, route references, and evidence hashes.

quality_flags.description: Audit quality flags clients must preserve.

question_readiness.description: Per-question answerability map for agents: current state, drivers, canonical event, seven-day history, constituent attribution, presentation parity, TRIDENT, and publication safety.

route.description: REST route used by the MCP tool.

source_date.description: Latest source date represented by the audit payload.

threshold_contract.description: Versioned release-event threshold contract used by audit-mode threshold flags.

threshold_flags.description: Canonical release-event threshold flags and pass/fail/unavailable status.

trident.description: TRIDENT and liquidation-gradient availability boundary. Returns unavailable unless explicit liquidation-gradient evidence is persisted.

z_scores.description: Audit-window z-score fields for ECS, LSI, FDI, FEI, ST, MP, AP, and basis pressure.

mcp_summary.description: Concise high-signal summary of the tool response. Maximum 140 characters.

provenance.description: Traceability information for the MCP tool response.

compacted.description: Whether the data payload was compacted for MCP context safety.

elapsed_ms.description: Elapsed time for the MCP tool call in milliseconds.

freshness_window_hours.description: Freshness window in hours when reported by the underlying tool.

latest_activity_source_date.description: Latest CompanyFacts activity source date when available.

latest_computed_source_date.description: Latest computed DeltaSignal source date when available.

source_date.description: Primary DeltaSignal source date when available.

suggested_follow_ups.description: Concrete next MCP calls an agent can run to continue the workflow.

args.description: Arguments for the suggested MCP tool call.

tool.description: MCP tool name to call next.

usage_metadata.description: Performance and estimated cost metadata for this MCP tool call.

elapsed_ms.description: Elapsed time for the MCP tool call in milliseconds.

estimated_cost_usd.description: Estimated public x402-equivalent cost in USD when known.
